Mod.name: Mahoraga: Adapt to Anything
Mod.description: A Mahoraga-inspired boss (8000 HP) waits at the eastern edge of every world. He adapts to every kind of harm, and every adaptation fully heals him and doubles his health and damage, teaching him techniques like Giant Nuke, World Cutting Slash, Omega Black Hole and Earthquake. Defeat him for Adapt to Anything and Summon Mahoraga. Also: the Divine Dogs perk and the Escape from Mahoraga mode (Mod settings).
